notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for ordinary object removal delivery. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies adapter-supplied object-class and attribute lookups, publication, active subscription, object registration and discovery, ordinary Delete Object Instance delivery, removal tag and producer metadata, sender exclusion, and standard federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object-class lookup, publication, active subscription, registration, ordinary Delete Object Instance, unsubscription, unpublication, resignation, and disconnect services with FederateAmbassador discovery and removeObjectInstance callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador object-removal and FederateAmbassador discovery/removal declarations
